FEAT-2-S102.title: Define Specialty Identification Input/Output Contracts
FEAT-2-S102.description: Create Pydantic models for specialty identification inputs (free-text query, optional context) and outputs (NUCC codes, classifications, confidence scores) to standardize service interfaces and tool usage.

FEAT-2-S103.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Tool Router
FEAT-2-S103.description: Register specialty identification as an allowlisted tool in tool_router, enabling LLM-driven invocation with validated inputs and structured outputs for downstream workflows.

FEAT-2-S104.title: Integrate Specialty Identification into FindCare Facade
FEAT-2-S104.description: Wire specialty identification into find_care_facade to ensure user queries are enriched with NUCC mappings before provider search execution, supporting end-to-end orchestration.

FEAT-2-S105.title: Validate NUCC Data Coverage and Mapping Consistency
FEAT-2-S105.description: Verify that loaded specialty taxonomy data (NUCC codes) supports expected mappings, including completeness checks, duplicate handling, and alignment with specialty_service outputs.
